name: scala-cask-api
title: Scala Cask API
blurb: Scala 3 JSON service on Cask: pure request contract, utest suite, one assembly jar for the socket check
default_description: A Scala 3 JSON web service on Cask.

verify.name: package
verify.cmd: mkdir -p bin && scala-cli --power package . -o bin/{{ npm_name }}.jar --assembly -f

verify.name: http
verify.cmd:
PORT=5419 java -jar bin/{{ npm_name }}.jar > .cask.log 2>&1 &
server=$!
ready=1
for _ in $(seq 1 120); do
  if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5419/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=0; break; fi
  sleep 0.5
done
if [ "$ready" != 0 ]; then
  cat .cask.log
  kill $server 2>/dev/null || true
  wait $server 2>/dev/null || true
  exit 1
fi
health=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5419/health)
stats=$(curl -fsS 'http://127.0.0.1:5419/stats?text=hello%20world%0A')
posted=$(curl -fsS -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary '{"text":"a b\nc\n"}' http://127.0.0.1:5419/stats)
missing=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:5419/stats)
broken=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary 'nope' http://127.0.0.1:5419/stats)
gone=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:5419/nope)
wrong=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X DELETE http://127.0.0.1:5419/health)
kill $server 2>/dev/null || true
wait $server 2>/dev/null || true
test "$health" = '{"status":"ok"}' || { echo "health: $health"; exit 1; }
printf '%s' "$stats" | grep -q '"lines":1' || { echo "stats: $stats"; exit 1; }
printf '%s' "$stats" | grep -q '"bytes":12' || { echo "stats: $stats"; exit 1; }
printf '%s' "$posted" | grep -q '"words":3' || { echo "posted: $posted"; exit 1; }
test "$missing" = 422 || { echo "missing: $missing"; exit 1; }
test "$broken" = 422 || { echo "broken: $broken"; exit 1; }
test "$gone" = 404 || { echo "gone: $gone"; exit 1; }
test "$wrong" = 405 || { echo "wrong: $wrong"; exit 1; }
echo "the service answered every check"
